config.elytra-vario.enabled.tooltip: Show or hide all Elytra Vario instruments.
config.elytra-vario.hudGlidingOnly.toolt: Show the HUD only while elytra gliding.
config.elytra-vario.showLadder.tooltip: Show or hide the pitch ladder. The master HUD setting still applies.
config.elytra-vario.ladderGlidingOnly.to: Show the pitch ladder only while elytra gliding.
config.elytra-vario.ladderOpacity.toolti: Multiplies rung and label opacity; ladder-marker colors are independent.
config.elytra-vario.showLadderLabels.too: Show numeric labels on the major pitch rungs.
config.elytra-vario.ladderCenterGap.tool: Half-width of the crosshair gap; also positions ladder markers.
config.elytra-vario.ladderFineLength.too: Length on each side of the center gap.
config.elytra-vario.ladderMinorLength.to: Length on each side of the center gap.
config.elytra-vario.ladderMajorLength.to: Length on each side of the center gap.
config.elytra-vario.ladderPrimeLength.to: Length on each side of the center gap.
config.elytra-vario.ladderHorizonExtra.t: Length on each side of the center gap.
config.elytra-vario.ladderBandFractionUp: Percentage of the distance from screen center to the top edge. Also applies to ladder markers; does not change field of view.
config.elytra-vario.ladderBandFractionDo: Percentage of the distance from screen center to the bottom edge. Shared by ladder markers.
config.elytra-vario.showFineTicks.toolti: Show fine pitch ticks near the camera pitch.
config.elytra-vario.ladderFineRangeDegre: Angular distance from the camera pitch over which fine ticks fade out.
config.elytra-vario.ladderFadeFraction.t: Outer portion of the ladder band where rungs and ladder markers fade out.
config.elytra-vario.showLadderMarkers.to: Show or hide all ladder markers. The master HUD setting still applies.
config.elytra-vario.ladderMarkersGliding: Show ladder markers only while elytra gliding.
config.elytra-vario.showLookaheadPitch.t: Marks the pitch that would maximize total-energy gain over the lookahead duration if pitch and yaw stayed constant. Uses free-flight elytra physics without rockets, collisions, or Slow Falling.
config.elytra-vario.showHoldPitch.toolti: Marks the pitch that would preserve the current flight-path angle on the next tick. Uses free-flight elytra physics and is hidden when no solution lies within the ladder bounds.
config.elytra-vario.showOptimalPitch.too: Marks the pitch that would maximize total-energy gain over the next tick. Uses free-flight elytra physics without rockets, collisions, or Slow Falling; it does not optimize an entire pump cycle.
config.elytra-vario.showFlightPath.toolt: Marks the current 3D velocity direction relative to the camera. Vertical offset shows flight-path pitch; horizontal offset shows sideslip.
config.elytra-vario.lookaheadTicks.toolt: Duration used to estimate the lookahead optimal pitch. Longer durations can produce a different optimum and require more computation.
Color and opacity of the lookahead optimal-pitch marker.
config.elytra-vario.holdPitchColor.toolt: Color and opacity of the flight-path hold marker.
config.elytra-vario.optimalPitchColor.to: Color and opacity of the one-tick optimal-pitch marker.
Clearance between the marker's outside edge and the ladder.
config.elytra-vario.lookaheadPitchLength: Horizontal length from the marker's outside edge to its point.
config.elytra-vario.lookaheadPitchStep.t: Rows per one-pixel horizontal step. Set to 0 for a one-row line.
config.elytra-vario.holdPitchInset.toolt: Clearance between the marker's outside edge and the ladder.
config.elytra-vario.holdPitchLength.tool: Horizontal length from the marker's outside edge to its point.
config.elytra-vario.holdPitchStep.toolti: Rows per one-pixel horizontal step. Set to 0 for a one-row line.
config.elytra-vario.optimalPitchInset.to: Clearance between the marker's outside edge and the ladder.
config.elytra-vario.optimalPitchLength.t: Horizontal length from the marker's outside edge to its point.
config.elytra-vario.optimalPitchStep.too: Rows per one-pixel horizontal step. Set to 0 for a one-row line.
config.elytra-vario.showMaxHorizontalSpe: Marks the constant +53.366° pitch for maximum steady-state horizontal speed (67.776 b/s).
config.elytra-vario.maxHorizontalSpeedPi: Color and opacity of the maximum-horizontal-speed marker.
Clearance between the marker's outside edge and the ladder.
Horizontal length from the marker's outside edge to its point.
Rows per one-pixel horizontal step. Set to 0 for a one-row line.
config.elytra-vario.showMinimumFallSpeed: Marks the constant −13.233° pitch for minimum steady-state fall speed (−1.416 b/s vertical).
config.elytra-vario.minimumFallSpeedPitc: Color and opacity of the minimum-fall-speed marker.
Clearance between the marker's outside edge and the ladder.
Horizontal length from the marker's outside edge to its point.
Rows per one-pixel horizontal step. Set to 0 for a one-row line.
config.elytra-vario.showZeroPitch.toolti: Marks 0° pitch, which maximizes steady-state glide ratio at about 10.1 blocks forward per block down.
config.elytra-vario.zeroPitchColor.toolt: Color and opacity of the zero-pitch marker.
config.elytra-vario.zeroPitchInset.toolt: Clearance between the marker's outside edge and the ladder.
config.elytra-vario.zeroPitchLength.tool: Horizontal length from the marker's outside edge to its point.
config.elytra-vario.zeroPitchStep.toolti: Rows per one-pixel horizontal step. Set to 0 for a one-row line.
config.elytra-vario.flightPathColor.tool: Color and opacity of the flight-path marker.
config.elytra-vario.showChart.tooltip: Show or hide the velocity graph. The master HUD setting still applies.
config.elytra-vario.chartGlidingOnly.too: Show the velocity graph only while elytra gliding.
config.elytra-vario.chartX.tooltip: Left edge measured from the screen's left edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.chartY.tooltip: Top edge measured from the screen's top edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.chartSize.tooltip: Exact width in scaled GUI pixels. Height follows the axis ranges, up to 512 pixels.
config.elytra-vario.chartMinVxz.tooltip: Axis bound in blocks per second. Minimum must be below maximum, with a span of at least 1 b/s.
config.elytra-vario.chartMaxVxz.tooltip: Axis bound in blocks per second. Minimum must be below maximum, with a span of at least 1 b/s.
config.elytra-vario.chartMinVy.tooltip: Axis bound in blocks per second. Minimum must be below maximum, with a span of at least 1 b/s.
config.elytra-vario.chartMaxVy.tooltip: Axis bound in blocks per second. Minimum must be below maximum, with a span of at least 1 b/s.
config.elytra-vario.showTrail.tooltip: Show recent horizontal and vertical velocities as a fading trail.
config.elytra-vario.chartTrailTicks.tool: History length, assuming the normal 20 ticks per second.
config.elytra-vario.trailColor.tooltip: Color and maximum opacity of the velocity trail; older samples fade out.
config.elytra-vario.showEnergyField.tool: Colors the graph by the maximum one-tick total-energy change available at each velocity, assuming horizontal motion follows the look direction. Does not account for sideslip, rockets, or collisions.
Color for zero energy change. Opacity is fixed at 100%.
Color for energy gain. Opacity is fixed at 100%.
Color for energy loss. Opacity is fixed at 100%.
config.elytra-vario.chartFieldScale.tool: Energy gain or loss that produces half-strength heatmap color. Lower values emphasize changes near zero.
config.elytra-vario.showHorizontalCursor: Plots horizontal speed against vertical velocity.
config.elytra-vario.showForwardCursor.to: Plots forward velocity along the look direction against vertical velocity.
config.elytra-vario.cursorXzColor.toolti: Color and opacity of the horizontal-speed cursor.
config.elytra-vario.showHorizontalAccele: Shows where the horizontal-speed cursor would move after one second at its current measured acceleration.
config.elytra-vario.horizontalAccelerati: Color and opacity of the horizontal acceleration arrow.
config.elytra-vario.cursorForwardColor.t: Color and opacity of the forward-speed cursor.
config.elytra-vario.showForwardAccelerat: Shows where the forward-speed cursor would move after one second at its current measured acceleration.
config.elytra-vario.forwardAccelerationA: Color and opacity of the forward acceleration arrow.
config.elytra-vario.showGrid.tooltip: Show the velocity grid and highlighted zero axes.
config.elytra-vario.showAxisLabels.toolt: Show axis bounds and the horizontal origin in blocks per second.
config.elytra-vario.showStats.tooltip: Show or hide Flight Stats. The master HUD setting still applies.
config.elytra-vario.statsGlidingOnly.too: Show Flight Stats only while elytra gliding.
config.elytra-vario.showStatsOther.toolt: Show the panel containing pitch and glide-ratio readouts. Flight Stats and the master HUD must also be visible.
config.elytra-vario.statsOtherX.tooltip: Left edge measured from the screen's left edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.statsOtherY.tooltip: Top edge measured from the screen's top edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.statsOtherWidth.tool: Exact on-screen width. Independent of height, so it changes horizontal spacing without changing text size.
config.elytra-vario.statsOtherTextSize.t: How many times its own size the font is drawn at. Snapped to the nearest size that needs no interpolation, which is a multiple of one over your GUI scale — quarters at GUI scale 4, thirds at 3. The panel's height follows from it and the rows shown.
config.elytra-vario.showStatsOtherBorder: Draw an outline around this panel.
config.elytra-vario.showStatsSpeed.toolt: Show the panel containing vertical, horizontal, and total speed readouts. Flight Stats and the master HUD must also be visible.
config.elytra-vario.statsSpeedX.tooltip: Left edge measured from the screen's left edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.statsSpeedY.tooltip: Top edge measured from the screen's top edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.statsSpeedWidth.tool: Exact on-screen width. Independent of height, so it changes horizontal spacing without changing text size.
config.elytra-vario.statsSpeedTextSize.t: How many times its own size the font is drawn at. Snapped to the nearest size that needs no interpolation, which is a multiple of one over your GUI scale — quarters at GUI scale 4, thirds at 3. The panel's height follows from it and the rows shown.
config.elytra-vario.showStatsSpeedBorder: Draw an outline around this panel.
config.elytra-vario.showStatsAccel.toolt: Show the panel containing vertical, horizontal, and total acceleration readouts. Flight Stats and the master HUD must also be visible.
config.elytra-vario.statsAccelX.tooltip: Left edge measured from the screen's left edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.statsAccelY.tooltip: Top edge measured from the screen's top edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.statsAccelWidth.tool: Exact on-screen width. Independent of height, so it changes horizontal spacing without changing text size.
config.elytra-vario.statsAccelTextSize.t: How many times its own size the font is drawn at. Snapped to the nearest size that needs no interpolation, which is a multiple of one over your GUI scale — quarters at GUI scale 4, thirds at 3. The panel's height follows from it and the rows shown.
config.elytra-vario.showStatsAccelBorder: Draw an outline around this panel.
config.elytra-vario.showStatsEnergy.tool: Show the panel containing kinetic energy, potential energy, total energy, and cycle gain. Flight Stats and the master HUD must also be visible.
config.elytra-vario.statsEnergyX.tooltip: Left edge measured from the screen's left edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.statsEnergyY.tooltip: Top edge measured from the screen's top edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.statsEnergyWidth.too: Exact on-screen width. Independent of height, so it changes horizontal spacing without changing text size.
How many times its own size the font is drawn at. Snapped to the nearest size that needs no interpolation, which is a multiple of one over your GUI scale — quarters at GUI scale 4, thirds at 3. The panel's height follows from it and the rows shown.
config.elytra-vario.showStatsEnergyBorde: Draw an outline around this panel.
config.elytra-vario.showStatsBounceVeloc: Show the touch, leave, and deploy velocity matrix. Flight Stats and the master HUD must also be visible.
config.elytra-vario.statsBounceVelocityX: Left edge measured from the screen's left edge in scaled GUI pixels.
config.elytra-vario.statsBounceVelocityY: Top edge measured from the screen's top edge in scaled GUI pixels.
config.elytra-vario.statsBounceVelocityW: Exact on-screen width. Independent of height, so it changes matrix spacing without changing text size.
config.elytra-vario.statsBounceVelocityT: How many times its own size the font is drawn at. Snapped to the nearest size that needs no interpolation, which is a multiple of one over your GUI scale — quarters at GUI scale 4, thirds at 3. The panel's height follows from it and the rows shown.
config.elytra-vario.showStatsBounceVeloc: Draw an outline around this panel.
config.elytra-vario.showStatsBounceDista: Show displacement from touch to leave and from leave to deploy. Flight Stats and the master HUD must also be visible.
config.elytra-vario.statsBounceDistanceX: Left edge measured from the screen's left edge in scaled GUI pixels.
config.elytra-vario.statsBounceDistanceY: Top edge measured from the screen's top edge in scaled GUI pixels.
config.elytra-vario.statsBounceDistanceW: Exact on-screen width. Independent of height, so it changes matrix spacing without changing text size.
config.elytra-vario.statsBounceDistanceT: How many times its own size the font is drawn at. Snapped to the nearest size that needs no interpolation, which is a multiple of one over your GUI scale — quarters at GUI scale 4, thirds at 3. The panel's height follows from it and the rows shown.
config.elytra-vario.showStatsBounceDista: Draw an outline around this panel.
config.elytra-vario.showStatsBounceTicks: Show elapsed ticks from touch to leave and from leave to deploy. Flight Stats and the master HUD must also be visible.
config.elytra-vario.statsBounceTicksX.to: Left edge measured from the screen's left edge in scaled GUI pixels.
config.elytra-vario.statsBounceTicksY.to: Top edge measured from the screen's top edge in scaled GUI pixels.
config.elytra-vario.statsBounceTicksWidt: Exact on-screen width. Independent of height, so it changes matrix spacing without changing text size.
config.elytra-vario.statsBounceTicksText: How many times its own size the font is drawn at. Snapped to the nearest size that needs no interpolation, which is a multiple of one over your GUI scale — quarters at GUI scale 4, thirds at 3. The panel's height follows from it and the rows shown.
config.elytra-vario.showStatsBounceTicks: Draw an outline around this panel.
Show signed vertical velocity at touch, leave, and deploy. The only one of the three that can be negative, and so the only one that carries a sign or takes the sign colors.
config.elytra-vario.showBounceVelocityXz: Show horizontal speed at touch, leave, and deploy. A speed rather than a component, so it is never negative.
config.elytra-vario.showBounceVelocityXy: Show total speed at touch, leave, and deploy. A speed rather than a component, so it is never negative.
Show signed height gained or lost over each consecutive event interval. The only one of the three that can be negative, and so the only one that carries a sign or takes the sign colors.
config.elytra-vario.showBounceDistanceXz: Show ground-track distance over each consecutive event interval. A distance rather than a component, so it is never negative.
config.elytra-vario.showBounceDistanceXy: Show straight-line distance over each consecutive event interval. A distance rather than a component, so it is never negative.
config.elytra-vario.showBounceTicks.tool: Show the elapsed ticks for touch-to-leave and leave-to-deploy.
config.elytra-vario.showPitch.tooltip: Camera pitch in degrees; positive values point downward.
config.elytra-vario.showGlideRatio.toolt: Horizontal blocks traveled per vertical block lost; negative while climbing.
Horizontal (XZ) speed in blocks per second.
config.elytra-vario.showTotalSpeed.toolt: Total (XYZ) speed in blocks per second.
config.elytra-vario.showVerticalSpeed.to: Signed vertical (Y) speed in blocks per second.
config.elytra-vario.showHorizontalAccele: Show the signed rate of change of horizontal speed on Flight Stats' Acceleration panel.
config.elytra-vario.showTotalAcceleratio: Show the signed rate of change of total speed on Flight Stats' Acceleration panel.
config.elytra-vario.showVerticalAccelera: Show the signed rate of change of vertical velocity on Flight Stats' Acceleration panel.
config.elytra-vario.showKineticEnergy.to: Kinetic energy expressed as the equivalent height in blocks.
Altitude in blocks, using the selected energy reference.
config.elytra-vario.showTotalEnergy.tool: Potential plus kinetic energy, expressed as height and using the selected energy reference.
config.elytra-vario.showCycleGain.toolti: Total-energy change over the most recently detected glide cycle.
config.elytra-vario.energyReference.tool: Reference for potential and total energy on the Energy panel. Since-apex values require a detected apex; absolute values do not. Both draws the two side by side under ABS and REL headings, with kinetic energy under ABS and the cycle gain under REL; it is the widest this panel goes and so what its minimum width is measured against.
config.elytra-vario.positiveColor.toolti: Color and opacity for positive signed Flight Stats values, including e-bounce values and elapsed ticks.
config.elytra-vario.negativeColor.toolti: Color and opacity for negative signed Flight Stats values, including e-bounce values.
config.elytra-vario.title: Elytra Vario Settings
config.elytra-vario.layout.title: HUD layout
config.elytra-vario.layout.tooltip: Move and resize HUD modules directly over the game view.
config.elytra-vario.keyBindings.tooltip: Lists every Elytra Vario key binding in Minecraft's Controls screen.
config.elytra-vario.positionMargin.toolt: Gap used for spaced snapping between modules and screen edges.
config.elytra-vario.positionSnapDistance: How far a dragged module or resize grip may jump to an alignment. Set to 0 to snap only at an exact alignment. Arrow keys and coordinate fields do not snap.
config.elytra-vario.range: Axis minimum must be below maximum (span ≥ 1 b/s).
config.elytra-vario.size: Each graph dimension must be 2–512 pixels.
config.elytra-vario.markerSize: Each ladder marker must fit inside the ladder's center gap.
config.elytra-vario.save_error: Could not save settings; they apply for this session only. See the game log.
config.elytra-vario.visibilityKey.toolti: Toggles the entire HUD and saves its visibility.
config.elytra-vario.toggleKey.tooltip: Toggles this instrument and saves its visibility.
config.elytra-vario.positionEditor.toolt:
%s
Drag the middle to move; drag a corner to resize. Hold Shift to disable snapping. Click to select its settings, then use the arrow keys for one-pixel moves. Right click to open the context menu.
config.elytra-vario.showBarSpeedo.toolti: Show or hide the bar speedometer. The master HUD setting still applies.
config.elytra-vario.barSpeedoGlidingOnly: Show the bar speedometer only while elytra gliding.
config.elytra-vario.barSpeedoX.tooltip: Left edge measured from the screen's left edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.barSpeedoY.tooltip: Top edge measured from the screen's top edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.barSpeedoHeight.tool: Height of the bar plot in scaled GUI pixels.
config.elytra-vario.barSpeedoMaxSpeed.to: Speed at the top of the bars; zero is at the bottom. Bars above the limit stop at the top and use the off-scale color.
config.elytra-vario.showBarSpeedoTotal.t: XYZ speed: sqrt(vx² + vy² + vz²). Always at least as large as either component bar.
Color and opacity of the total-speed bar.
config.elytra-vario.showBarSpeedoHorizon: XZ speed: sqrt(vx² + vz²). It coincides with total speed in level flight.
config.elytra-vario.barSpeedoHorizontalC: Color and opacity of the horizontal-speed bar.
config.elytra-vario.showBarSpeedoVertica: |vy|. This bar shows magnitude only; Flight Stats' SPEED Y row shows the sign.
config.elytra-vario.barSpeedoVerticalCol: Color and opacity of the vertical-speed bar.
config.elytra-vario.showBarSpeedoAcceler: Project each bar's measured acceleration one second forward from its current speed as a centered white arrow.
config.elytra-vario.showBarSpeedoMaxHori: Thin white lines at the steady |Y|, XZ, and XYZ speeds for +53.366° flight: 20.191, 67.776, and 70.719 b/s.
config.elytra-vario.showBarSpeedoTermina: Thin gray lines at the straight-down terminal |Y|, XZ, and XYZ speeds: 78.400, 0, and 78.400 b/s.
Label each major tick with its speed in blocks per second.
config.elytra-vario.barSpeedoOpacity.too: Opacity of the background behind the chart.
config.elytra-vario.barSpeedoMajorStep.t: Spacing of the long, labeled ticks, measured from zero.
config.elytra-vario.barSpeedoPeggedColor: Color and opacity used when a bar exceeds the scale limit.
config.elytra-vario.showDialSpeedo.toolt: Show or hide the dial speedometer. The master HUD setting still applies.
config.elytra-vario.dialSpeedoGlidingOnl: Show the dial speedometer only while elytra gliding.
config.elytra-vario.dialSpeedoX.tooltip: Left edge measured from the screen's left edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.dialSpeedoY.tooltip: Top edge measured from the screen's top edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.dialSpeedoRadius.too: Arc radius in scaled GUI pixels. The half disc is slightly wider than two radii and half as tall as it is wide.
config.elytra-vario.dialSpeedoMaxSpeed.t: Speed at the arc's right end; zero is at the left. Needles above the limit stop at the end and use the off-scale color.
XYZ speed: sqrt(vx² + vy² + vz²). The longest needle and always at least as large as the other two.
config.elytra-vario.dialSpeedoTotalColor: Color and opacity of the total-speed needle.
config.elytra-vario.showDialSpeedoHorizo: XZ speed: sqrt(vx² + vz²). The middle-length needle; it coincides with total speed in level flight.
config.elytra-vario.dialSpeedoHorizontal: Color and opacity of the horizontal-speed needle.
config.elytra-vario.showDialSpeedoVertic: |vy|. The shortest needle; it shows magnitude only. Flight Stats' SPEED Y row shows the sign.
config.elytra-vario.dialSpeedoVerticalCo: Color and opacity of the vertical-speed needle.
config.elytra-vario.showDialSpeedoAccele: Project each needle's measured acceleration one second forward as a concentric arrow at its tip, using the needle's color.
config.elytra-vario.showDialSpeedoMaxHor: Thin white marks across each needle's tip at the XYZ, XZ, and |Y| speeds for the steady +53.366° glide: 70.719, 67.776, and 20.191 b/s.
config.elytra-vario.showDialSpeedoTermin: Thin gray marks at the straight-down terminal XYZ, XZ, and |Y| speeds: 78.400, 0, and 78.400 b/s.
config.elytra-vario.showDialSpeedoLabels: Label each major tick with its speed in blocks per second.
config.elytra-vario.showDialSpeedoBorder: Outline the half disc's arc and straight lower edge.
config.elytra-vario.dialSpeedoOpacity.to: Opacity of the half-disc background; the corners remain undimmed.
Spacing of the long, labeled ticks, measured from zero.
Spacing of short, unlabeled ticks from zero. Major ticks cover coincident minor ticks.
config.elytra-vario.dialSpeedoPeggedColo: Color and opacity used when a needle exceeds the scale limit.
